title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
description: Entry-level AWS exam covering core cloud concepts, billing and basic services. No hands-on lab required to pass.
signalingNotes: Widely recognized entry credential; shows baseline cloud vocabulary rather than hands-on skill.

cloud-internship.rationale: Recognized by recruiters as an introductory signal.

source: Prototype sample data: exam fee from provider listing at time of writing (verify current price)

title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
description: Associate-level AWS exam on designing resilient, secure architectures. Commonly paired with hands-on practice labs.
signalingNotes: Frequently listed in cloud job descriptions; carries more weight than entry-level exams.

cloud-internship.rationale: Associate-level credential that maps to common cloud intern tasks.

source: Prototype sample data: exam fee from provider listing at time of writing (verify current price)

title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
description: Introductory Azure exam on cloud concepts, core services, pricing and governance.
signalingNotes: Introductory signal; student vouchers are sometimes available through campus programs.

cloud-internship.rationale: Introductory credential; useful mostly for Azure-focused employers.

title: Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
description: Associate-level Azure exam on identity, storage, compute and virtual networking administration.
signalingNotes: Hands-on administration credential; signals practical Azure operations skills.

cloud-internship.rationale: Associate-level; relevant for Azure-heavy teams.

title: HashiCorp Terraform Associate
description: Exam on infrastructure-as-code concepts and Terraform workflow.
signalingNotes: Signals infrastructure-as-code literacy, which many DevOps roles list.

cloud-internship.rationale: IaC appears in many DevOps and platform intern postings.

title: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer
description: Associate exam on deploying and operating workloads on Google Cloud.
signalingNotes: Associate-level signal, most relevant to Google Cloud shops.

cloud-internship.rationale: Associate-level credential for GCP-focused teams.

title: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
description: Entry-level exam on Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem.
signalingNotes: Niche but growing signal for platform and container-focused roles.

cloud-internship.rationale: Signals container literacy; less widely requested than AWS/Azure exams.

title: CompTIA Network+
description: Vendor-neutral networking exam covering protocols, troubleshooting and network security.
signalingNotes: Recognized foundation for networking; less cloud-specific.

cloud-internship.rationale: Networking foundation; indirectly relevant to cloud roles.

title: Serverless portfolio site on AWS
description: Build and deploy a personal site with a serverless visitor counter, infrastructure as code and an automated deploy pipeline.
signalingNotes: A public repo and live site give interviewers something concrete to discuss.

cloud-internship.rationale: Demonstrates hands-on work that can be shown in interviews.

title: Containerized app with Terraform and GitHub Actions
description: Containerize a small web app, provision it with Terraform and deploy it through a CI/CD pipeline.
signalingNotes: Shows an end-to-end DevOps workflow; depth of the write-up matters.

cloud-internship.rationale: Mirrors common DevOps intern tasks.

title: Linux home lab and networking project
description: Set up a small Linux server, configure networking, firewall rules and monitoring, and document the setup.
signalingNotes: Good talking point for operations-focused roles; less visible than a public repo.

cloud-internship.rationale: Builds fundamentals; signaling depends on documentation.

title: Weekend hackathon
description: Short-format team event (often 24–48 hours) building a prototype, sometimes with cloud credits from sponsors.
signalingNotes: Sponsors and recruiters sometimes attend; outcomes vary widely by event.

timingWindows.label: Event season
timingWindows.note: Many collegiate hackathons run in fall and spring.

timingWindows.label: Event season
timingWindows.note: Many collegiate hackathons run in fall and spring.

cloud-internship.rationale: Short event; signaling depends on the project and connections made.

title: Student cloud computing club
description: Campus club running cloud workshops, study groups for certifications and employer info sessions.
signalingNotes: Leadership roles signal more than general membership.

cloud-internship.rationale: Peer study and employer sessions; signaling grows with a leadership role.

title: Officer role in a technical student org
description: Officer position (e.g. in an ACM, NSBE, SHPE or similar chapter) organizing events and coordinating with sponsors.
signalingNotes: Shows leadership and sponsor contact; skill-building is less technical.

timingWindows.label: Officer elections
timingWindows.note: Many chapters elect officers in spring for the next year.

cloud-internship.rationale: Leadership signal and recruiter access through sponsors.

title: Cloud / SWE internship at a large tech company
description: Paid summer internship on a cloud, infrastructure or software engineering team.
signalingNotes: Strongest direct signal for a cloud role; highly competitive.

timingWindows.label: Early recruiting cycle
timingWindows.note: Many summer internship applications open August–October of the year before.

timingWindows.label: Internship term
timingWindows.note: Most programs run 10–12 weeks in summer.

cloud-internship.rationale: Direct experience in the target role.

title: Early-career program for first and second year students
description: Paid summer program for first- and second-year students, mixing a project with mentorship.
signalingNotes: Designed for students early in their degree; often leads into later internships.

timingWindows.label: Early recruiting cycle
timingWindows.note: Applications often open July–September and close early.

cloud-internship.rationale: Strong early signal; often a pipeline into later internships.

title: Part-time campus IT or research computing job
description: Paid part-time role supporting campus servers, labs or help desk, often with flexible hours.
signalingNotes: Real operations experience; recognized as relevant work history.

timingWindows.label: Campus hiring
timingWindows.note: Campus roles often hire at the start of each semester.

timingWindows.label: Campus hiring
timingWindows.note: Campus roles often hire at the start of each semester.

cloud-internship.rationale: Paid operations experience that can be listed as work history.

title: Part-time cloud operations internship at a startup
description: Part-time paid internship supporting cloud infrastructure at a small company.
signalingNotes: Hands-on scope can be broad; company name recognition varies.

timingWindows.label: Rolling hiring
timingWindows.note: Smaller companies often hire on a rolling basis.

cloud-internship.rationale: Direct cloud experience at smaller scale.

title: NSF REU in distributed or cloud systems
description: Funded summer research experience in a university lab working on distributed or cloud systems.
signalingNotes: Strong signal for research paths; relevant but indirect for industry cloud roles.

timingWindows.label: REU application window
timingWindows.note: Many REU applications are due between December and February.

cloud-internship.rationale: Shows systems depth; indirect for industry roles.

cs-phd.rationale: Research experience is central to PhD applications.

title: Semester research with a faculty cloud/HPC lab
description: Part-time undergraduate research during the semester, often for credit or a small stipend.
signalingNotes: Builds a faculty reference; industry signaling depends on the project.

cloud-internship.rationale: Faculty reference and systems exposure.

cs-phd.rationale: Faculty letters and research output matter for PhD admissions.
